avis.titre: A Desert Miracle - Burning Man Cleaning: T.N. Dickinson's Witch Hazel Astringent Review
avis.texte: As an avid festival-goer, I recently stumbled upon a game-changer for post-Burning Man cleanup – T.N. Dickinson's Witch Hazel Astringent for Face and Body. This unassuming product has proven to be an absolute miracle worker when it comes to banishing the notorious playa dust from clothing. In fact, it outshines the commonly recommended white vinegar, offering not only superior performance but also the added bonus of being odor-free. The first thing that caught my attention was the versatility of this witch hazel astringent. While primarily designed for facial and body use, its efficacy in dust removal is nothing short of remarkable. After a week of frolicking in the desert at Burning Man, my clothes were caked with the stubborn playa dust, notorious for its resilience. I had tried the vinegar soak method in the past, but the results were inconsistent, and the lingering smell was less than pleasant. Enter T.N. Dickinson's Witch Hazel Astringent. I was skeptical at first, but the moment I applied it to a dust-covered pair of pants, the transformation was astounding. The astringent not only cut through the dust with ease but also left the fabric feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. Unlike vinegar, there was no overpowering scent, making the cleaning process far more enjoyable. The secret to its success lies in the gentle yet effective nature of witch hazel. Witch hazel is great! I was looking for 100% witch hazel and this fit the bill. It can be used as an astringent directly on your skin. It is also antimicrobial. I mix it with a little lavender essential oil, tea tree oil (which has natural antiseptic and anti fungal properties also) and some distilled water to create a spray for my yoga mat. I use this everyday after my practice, between regular mat washings. It keeps everything smelling clean and fresh for the poses where your face is directly on the mat, and it kills the germs too.

avis.titre: Great for oily, acne prone skin. Great toner!
avis.texte: I literally love this stuff! This is my second purchase of my bottle from Pharmapacks. It's always sealed & packaged properly & they usually give you a discount for your next purchase! I use this as a natural facial toner. I cleanse with my cleanser and then wet a cotton ball with the witch hazel & apply it to my face twice a day, every other day. It's great for oily, acne prone skin. It minimizes the amount of oil I get and unclogs my pores! It's also great for cystic pimples. It seems that this has also brightened my skin tone up a bit too. I noticed this bottle does contain 12% alcohol, but my skin can handle it. It never dries my skin out. Most store bought toners contain way more than that anyway! Just be careful with this if you have dry skin. If you do, you can try diluting it. It lasts for a pretty long time ... maybe 3-6 months or so? The smell is pretty bad at first.Indescribable. I remember almost throwing up the first time I opened the bottle! After a couple weeks, you definitely get used to the smell. I've been using it for about a year and I don't notice it anymore. Will definitely purchase again!

avis.titre: Great value for what I already know (from past use) is a quality product.
avis.texte: I just wanted to leave an up to date review, since I know that some buyers said they had issues with this six-pack. I have had no problems at all, no funny smell or anything like that in my delivery (one review said that they smelled something “moldy”; I had no problems like that with the box I received, and no negative issues with the delivery or anything else. Buy with confidence. Witch Hazel is good to have around the house. WH is a good Astringent, provides care for small cuts and abrasions, and, for my purposes, After-shave. I don’t like all that perfumey stuff, I just want something to put on my face and neck after shaving that doesn’t contain somebody else’s idea of a “good smell”.

I have recently been suffering from acne on my face and back. I was desperate to find something to fix the problem, but nothing seemed to work. Three weeks ago, I found a recipe for a toner on the internet using ¾ cups of witch hazel with 15 drops of tea tree essential oil (I used plant therapy). Magically, the toner worked! I have noticed a world of difference on my skin. My skin is less oily, my acne scars are beginning to fade, and I have less pimples than before. I can’t recommend this enough if you are suffering from acne. This product deserves FIVE stars!
